message: You are tired because nothing is rooted; a rooted life is fed from somewhere you cannot see.
arc: man-in-hole: the dry life → the tree by the stream → how to put roots down

intro.shows: Rooted (series name set small above the week's title)
intro.idea: series name gathers from wide tracking as the first sentence lands
intro.purpose: Names the series without a sting or logo animation.

outro.idea: the verse he closes on, set once, no logo bumper
outro.purpose: Ends on the text, not on branding.

beats.line: I want to start with a confession…
beats.purpose: Personal story; the face carries it.

beats.line: What if the reason you feel so tired is that nothing in your life has roots?
beats.purpose: The sermon's question, stated once, on the word 'roots'.

beats.line: sending out its roots by the stream
beats.purpose: The image the sermon returns to.

beats.line: So how do you actually put roots down?
